$comment: RFC 0193 §B — the seat for the v1 map. `versioning.md` axis 6 rules this axis first-class with its own grammar; the generated record had the `retire` shape instead. propertyNames is the kind grammar rather than a closed enum: axis 6 says `additionalProperties: false over declared kinds`, but a vendor kind is host-published and never corpus-declared (`ai-envelope.schema.json` requires exactly that), so a literal enum would forbid the entries the catalog exists to carry. RFC 0193 §D corrects the axis row to match.

kinds.description: Active schema version per envelope kind, as in v1 `Capabilities.schemaVersions` (e.g. `{"vendor.acme.prd.create": 2}`). A kind absent from this map has no advertised floor; an emitted `schemaVersion` is then compared against 0. An emitted version HIGHER than the advertised floor MUST be refused with `unknown_schema_version` regardless of strictness; LOWER is governed by `envelopeStrictness.mode` (`events.md` §"The envelope-kind catalog").
